'''Brace Team''' was a military unit founded by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The group was composed of some of the Alliance's better gunners and heavy weapons specialists. Their missions tended to involve laying down a layer of heavy covering fire between Rebel forces and those of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Tren]] [[Opit-Wenbruh]] served as a member of Brace Team after his previous group, [[Scandium Team]], was disbanded.
